jobs.title: Senior Robotics Engineer - Tel Aviv
jobs.description: Demonstrated senior-level research or innovation record (e.g., peer-reviewed publications, meaningful patents, major contributions, open-source robotics infrastructure, or deployed advanced robotic systems) Led at least one full-cycle research or advanced R&D project from problem formulation through implementation, experimental validation, and tangible outcome Strong hands-on experience with real robots in research, advanced prototyping, or production-like experimental settings
